title: DualShock input capture integrity and evidence hardening
evidence_limits: All tests use synthetic logs and host mocks; no physical PS3 input logs have been captured.
Independent button/axis/trigger telemetry does not establish native Local Client 1, a second player entity, camera, HUD or playable Campaign co-op.
The exact Campaign and Multiplayer SEG0/SEG1 runtime dumps and corresponding capture metadata remain required for PPU/Ghidra analysis.
next_gate: Collect genuine Campaign and Multiplayer Input Probe v1 logs, Pad Probe v4 logs, PS3MAPI SEG0/SEG1 dumps and matching metadata, then run analyze_tu116_runtime_capture.py with both input-log arguments and Ghidra enabled.
